title: Timesheets Create & Edit lets the user edit entries
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Timesheets View and Create & Edit ON, and Reports ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open the timesheet activities report from Reports.
  2. Edit an entry.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: the timesheet entry EDIT affordance was not reachable in the harness for a timesheetsCreateAndEdit role — the WO Timesheets tab is a summary (no edit for view or C&E) and the /timesheets page exposed no per-row edit control/dialog/menu on click. Needs the timesheet entry editor (real browser) to confirm edit works; view-only read-only is confirmed (C26430).
